metadata.title: PRISM Reconstruction & Masked Representation Learning Laboratory
metadata.description: Investigation of visual representations emerging from masked patch reconstruction (MIM) and denoising autoencoders (DAE) across CNN, ResNet, and ViT encoders compared against supervised and SimCLR baselines.
